recognize_zh: 數顆中大型母細胞，圓形核佔滿細胞、染色質細緻均勻，只有一圈淡藍色少量細胞質，無顆粒；其中一顆核緣不規則並有摺痕，屬淋巴母細胞形態，是否為 T 細胞系需靠免疫表型。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with finely granular, evenly dispersed chromatin; one with irregular, convoluted nuclear edge
Thin rim of scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm, one with a small cytoplasmic vacuole
Sparse background with few red cells and faint proteinaceous material
describe_en: Smear shows a small group of medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and a thin rim of scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm. One blast shows an irregular, convoluted nuclear contour and another a small cytoplasmic vacuole. The background is sparse, so the specimen type and overall cellularity cannot be assessed from this field. Findings are consistent with lymphoblasts; T-lineage requires immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.vs: B-lymphoblasts look the same and require flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, CD79a) to separate from T-lymphoblasts (cytoplasmic CD3, CD7).
Agranular myeloblasts overlap morphologically but are MPO or CD13/CD33/CD117 positive by flow cytometry.
ETP-ALL is morphologically similar and is defined by immunophenotype (CD1a and CD8 negative, CD5 weak, stem/myeloid markers positive).
